title: WSJ claim that Air Force hazing rituals explain UFO mythology

tellings.quote: Okay, and then you have this second claim that the article makes, that Air Force hazing rituals explain widespread UFO mythology.
But I'm optimistic after this Wall Street Journal article. The reason being I think it's really interesting. They say it's all part of this Air Force hazing ritual
tellings.difference: The host says the article makes him optimistic and does not name the reporter.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the Wall Street Journal article's claim that UFO stories come from an Air Force hazing ritual.

as_told.title: Wall Street Journal: UFO stories as an Air Force hazing ritual

plain: A 2025 Wall Street Journal article titled "The Pentagon Disinformation That Fueled America's UFO Mythology", by the reporter Joel Schectman, claims that hazing rituals inside the US Air Force explain much of America's widespread UFO lore. Michels walks through that claim on the show, calling it the article's "second claim". In a later episode he says, without naming the reporter, that the article actually makes him optimistic, because he finds the hazing explanation "really interesting".
